system.description:
You anchor webbing between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) that are capable of bearing the tension. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 10 feet tall and 1 foot thick and can be shaped to follow the design of available surfaces. Creatures treat other creatures on opposite sides as lightly obscuring.

If a creature attempts to pass through the wall, they must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they become Restrained within the walls space for the duration. A Restrained creature can spend their Action to make a Strength saving throw, escaping on a success.

The Wall has an AC equal to your jutsu save DC, and each 10-foot section has 20 hit points, being able to destroyed independently. The wall has immunity to bludgeoning, poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to fire damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the hit points of each wall section by +15. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, the wall becomes heavily obscurement for creatures on opposite sides. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, its duration becomes 1 Hour and no longer requires concentration.
